title: backlog.py new misses a repro's own error when FORCE_COLOR colours Python's traceback
goal: backlog.py new recognises a repro that fails for its own error (SyntaxError, argparse usage error) when the child's stderr carries ANSI colour codes, as Python 3.14 writes under FORCE_COLOR (set to 3 in Claude Code background sessions): the repro runs with colour off (NO_COLOR=1, FORCE_COLOR and PYTHON_COLORS removed from its environment) or its output is matched with colour codes stripped; the own-error tests set FORCE_COLOR themselves so they fail on any host while the defect is there. Found landing SP-rhgeod5g: the sync gate's tests.py --changed failed test_repro_fails_for_its_own_error_syntax_error and _usage_error in a background session and passed with FORCE_COLOR unset.
